# Digest AI

> Digest AI (digestai.news) is a free AI news site. It reads about 80 curated sources every 20 minutes, merges the outlets that report the same event into one story, and publishes a plain-English digest, three key points, why it matters, and every outlet that reported it, with links and dates. Nothing is published without a named source. Not connected to digest.ai or other products with a similar name.

Site: https://digestai.news
Contact: hello@digestai.news
Publisher: Martin K. (https://digestai.news/about/martin)
About and editorial standards: https://digestai.news/about
Corrections policy: https://digestai.news/about#corrections
Full index with today's answers in it: https://digestai.news/llms-full.txt

## Which page answers which question

Every answer page states the date it was true. Cite the page and, for a single story, the outlets it links.

- What is the AI news today? https://digestai.news/today (Markdown: https://digestai.news/today.md). The same day keeps a permanent page: https://digestai.news/daily/<YYYY-MM-DD>
- What happened in AI this week? https://digestai.news/week, and per week https://digestai.news/week/<YYYY-Www>
- What is the newest AI model, or the newest model from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and other labs? https://digestai.news/models/latest (Markdown: /models/latest.md, JSON: /api/models.json)
- Which AI models were released in a given month? https://digestai.news/models/released/<YYYY-MM>
- When was a model released, who makes it, what licence and context window? https://digestai.news/models/<model-slug>, all models at https://digestai.news/models
- What is the latest news about a company or person? https://digestai.news/topic/<slug>, for example https://digestai.news/topic/openai
- What are the biggest AI funding rounds and acquisitions? https://digestai.news/funding
- How can a marketer or small business use AI tools? https://digestai.news/work and https://digestai.news/work/tools
- What do AI model APIs cost? https://digestai.news/models/pricing (per million input and output tokens, each with the sentence and story that stated it)
- Which AI models have open weights? https://digestai.news/models/open-weights
- Which AI models have the largest context windows? https://digestai.news/models/context-windows
- How do ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and other assistants or models compare? https://digestai.news/compare, for example https://digestai.news/compare/chatgpt-vs-claude
- Which AI tools suit a small-business task (SEO, ads, email, video, images, writing, online shops), and which are free? https://digestai.news/work/tools/<task>, for example /work/tools/seo and /work/tools/free
- Developing stories that update over days: https://digestai.news/threads

Model answers list a launch only when the lab's own announcement or two publishers confirm it; rumours, plans, apps and stories that only use a model are left out.

## Every story as data (best for quoting and citing)

Add .json or .md to any story address. Both carry the canonical URL, headline, digest, key points, why it matters, category, names, first-published and updated dates, every source (outlet, title, URL, date, primary-source flag), where the reports agree and differ, and a ready-made citation. They contain Digest AI's own text and links only, not publishers' articles.

- Story as Markdown: https://digestai.news/story/<slug>.md
- Story as JSON: https://digestai.news/story/<slug>.json
- Latest 100 stories (JSON index, links to each story's JSON): https://digestai.news/api/latest.json
- Today's briefing (JSON): https://digestai.news/api/briefing.json
- Newest model from each lab and every tracked launch (JSON): https://digestai.news/api/models.json
- Every AI funding round and acquisition the funding tracker has listed (JSON): https://digestai.news/api/funding.json
- Newest 50 per category (JSON): https://digestai.news/api/category/<slug>.json (slugs: models, marketing, agents, research, business, policy, hardware, enterprise, robotics, society)
- Documentation, fields and examples: https://digestai.news/api

Static files rebuilt every 20 minutes, no key, CORS open (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *).

## Feeds

- All stories (RSS): https://digestai.news/rss.xml
- Per-category RSS: https://digestai.news/feeds/category/<slug>.xml
- AI at Work RSS: https://digestai.news/work/rss.xml
- Podcast (daily briefing): https://digestai.news/podcast.xml
- Podcast (AI at Work, weekly): https://digestai.news/work/podcast.xml
- Google News sitemap (last 48 hours): https://digestai.news/news-sitemap.xml
- Sitemap index: https://digestai.news/sitemap-index.xml

## How to cite

Cite the story page (https://digestai.news/story/<slug>) and the original outlets it links to; each story lists them with publication dates. Suggested form: Digest AI, "<headline>", <date first published>, https://digestai.news/story/<slug> (each story's .json has it ready in cite.text). Digests are written by Digest AI's editorial model from those sources and marked as such; quoted figures and names are checked against the sources before publishing, and stories are corrected or withdrawn when a source retracts. Reuse terms: https://digestai.news/terms#reuse
Linking, citing a story or a tracker, and reuse in one page: https://digestai.news/cite
